headers.subject: OTP for Your ComBank Card Transaction

plain:
Dear Cardholder,

                    Please carefully check and verify the merchant name and transaction amount before proceeding with your online purchase. Keep your OTP (One-Time Password) confidential and do not share it with anyone.

                    Your OTP for the transaction at merchant 'ABC Company' for LKR 100.00 is 123456. Please use this code within the next ten (10) minutes to complete your purchase with your ComBank card ending in 2790.

                    Should you need further information, please reach out to our Contact Center at +94 (0) 112 353353.

                    Thank you for using Combank Card.

                    *** This email was automatically generated by the ComBank Card Centre. Please do not reply to this email ***
